caption:
Actually said. Oct 20 to Nov 17, 2026.

1. Netflix, Oct 20, 2026 (Letter to shareholders): "create member value that lets us occasionally raise prices"
Occasionally is doing a lot of work there. (Our take.)

2. Kimberly-Clark, Nov 2, 2026 (SEC filing on an integration program): "workforce optimization (approximately $0.4 billion)"
Optimizing a workforce sounds nicer than naming it. (Our take.)

3. Starbucks, Oct 29, 2026 (Earnings release): "closed approximately 250 company-operated North America coffeehouses that do not deliver the coffeehouse experience and financial performance expected of the brand"
Even the coffeehouses got a performance review. (Our take.)

4. Instacart (Maplebear Inc.), Oct 26, 2026 (SEC filing on winding down Caper Cart): "This decision was made to re-align resources to support the Company’s strategic priorities"
Re-align: corporate for switching it off. (Our take.)

5. Disney, Nov 17, 2026 (Letter to shareholders): "we do expect a portion to drop to the bottom line over time"
Growth first. The bottom line gets its turn. (Our take.)

The gray lines are real and untouched. The black lines are our take.

Sources: SEC EDGAR · Netflix, Oct 20, 2026; SEC EDGAR · Kimberly-Clark, Nov 2, 2026; SEC EDGAR · Starbucks, Oct 29, 2026; SEC EDGAR · Instacart, Oct 26, 2026; SEC EDGAR · Disney, Nov 17, 2026.

More at the link in bio.
